title: DerivedData (Xcode build results)
description: Intermediate files, indexes and build results of Xcode projects, one folder per project. ModuleCache is the shared cache of compiled modules.
regeneration: Xcode recreates them on the next build (the first build takes longer).

title: Device symbols (DeviceSupport)
description: Debug symbols copied from connected iPhones, iPads and watches, one folder per OS version.
regeneration: Xcode copies them again when you connect the device (a few minutes).

title: Xcode archives
description: Built app versions submitted to the App Store or TestFlight, with the dSYM files needed to read crash reports.
regeneration: The exact same build cannot be recreated.

title: SwiftUI previews
description: Simulators and builds used by SwiftUI Previews.

title: Xcode cache
description: Xcode app cache (including documentation and downloads).
